title: 第二十章 大比四第二十一章 大比五
content_zh:
晚饭后，百丈崖。
“我与娘站在半腰之处，看了你今日比试，自师弟登台，娘就没有停止过对你的夸奖。”
见到秦凤鸣到来，小师姐张若彤立即跳跃着来到他身边，用手拉着他的手，来到父母身前，口中喜色连连的说道。
听到小师姐如此言说，秦凤鸣登时满脸涨红，身躯一曲，便自跪倒在了师傅师娘身前：“弟子今天输了一场，有辱师门，还请师傅、师娘责罚。”
“哈哈哈，凤鸣，哪里用的着责罚，你所败的那场，为师已然知晓，此定然是你故意为之，此种缘由，为师也能辨出一二。
如此之小，就能有此知进退之心，却也极为难得。
你此时功力，让为师也是大吃一惊，就是那些堂主长老，也是吃惊不已。
均对你赞赏有加，如不是知晓你已是老夫弟子，定然会要争抢与你的。”
听到师傅如此言说，秦凤鸣登时受宠若惊，急忙叩头之下道：“这是师傅、师娘尽心教授之利，弟子不敢贪功。”
师傅夸奖完秦凤鸣，面色却是不由转为凝重，稍事思虑之后，面色郑重道：
“凤鸣，经过这一年习练，你对飘柳十三式剑法精髓，却也增深不少，以你此时功力，已然有了进入此次大比前十的实力。”
“什么？师傅是说，弟子此次进入精英堂，将大有希望吗？”
骤闻师傅此言，幼小的秦凤鸣登时几乎跳了起来。
见秦凤鸣兴奋至此，师傅微微一笑，再次开口道：
“凤鸣，你也不要高兴太早，这批弟子之中，却是有三四人，可能是你无法战胜之人，如你与之相遇，最终大有因力气不济而落败，但只要不过早与之相遇，进入前十，却也是极为可能之事。
如你成功进入前十，为师会亲自向司马门主推荐，让你进入暗夜堂。”
听到师傅此言，秦凤鸣却是面露一丝疑惑之色，暗夜堂是何所在，他一点也不知，但听师傅之意，似乎是一处更胜精英堂的所在一般。
“暗夜堂，乃是本门秘密堂口，只有本门最核心弟子才能进入，但知晓此堂口虚实之人，却是极少，就是为师也不知暗夜堂具体所在。
但只要进入暗夜堂，各种练武资源，将无限提供。
这可是本门任何弟子都向往之处。”

听师傅如此解说，秦凤鸣心中登时激动非常。
看来，这暗夜堂应该是落霞谷弟子终极目标无疑了。
虽然听师傅言说可以举荐他进入其中，但要获得此机会，秦凤鸣知晓，其必须要经过数道考验才可，以后比试，将容不得丝毫疏忽。
第二日，同样是那个山谷，热闹程度比起昨天有过之而无不及。
但是，今天参加比试的弟子，却仅剩昨日的半数了。
巳时，王长老再次来到了中央的高台前：
“今天比试，只剩三十二人，采取淘汰赛，获胜者将直接进入精英堂。
失败一方需要再另行进行比试，决出前四名，同样可以进精英堂继续深造。
好了，下面去领取号码牌。”
秦凤鸣跟随在其他弟子身后，也自领取了号码牌，此次号码牌依旧是随机分发，号牌之后，均自注示有各人名字。
“此次比试，仅在前方五号高台之处举行，第一号和三十二号弟子上台，二号与三十一号准备，依次类推。
content_en:
After dinner, Baizhang Cliff.
"My mother and I stood halfway together and watched your competition today. My mother has never stopped praising you since my junior brother came on stage."
Seeing Qin Fengming's arrival, junior sister Zhang Ruotong immediately jumped to his side, held his hand, came to his parents, and said with joy.
Hearing what the young senior sister said, Qin Fengming's face flushed immediately, and he knelt down in front of his master and his wife: "My disciple lost a game today, which is an insult to my sect. Please punish me, my master and my wife."
"Hahaha, Feng Ming, there is no point in punishing me. I already know the defeat you suffered. You must have done it deliberately. I can also tell the reason.
It is extremely rare for such a young person to have such a mind of knowing how to advance and retreat.
Your master is shocked by your current skills. Even the hall masters and elders are also surprised.
They all admire you very much. If they didn't know that you are my disciple, they would definitely compete with you. "
Hearing what the master said, Qin Fengming was immediately flattered and hurriedly kowtowed and said: "This is the benefit of master and master's dedicated teaching. Disciples dare not be greedy for credit."
After the master praised Qin Fengming, his expression turned solemn. After thinking for a moment, he said solemnly:
"Feng Ming, after this year of practice, your understanding of the essence of Piaoliu's Thirteen Styles of Swordsmanship has improved a lot. With your current skills, you already have the strength to enter the top ten in this competition."
"What? Master, are you saying that this disciple will have great hope after entering the Elite Hall?"
Upon hearing the master's words, the young Qin Fengming almost jumped up.
Seeing Qin Fengming's excitement, the master smiled slightly and said again:
"Feng Ming, don't be too happy. Among these disciples, there are three or four people who you may not be able to defeat. If you meet them, you will most likely lose due to lack of strength. However, as long as you don't meet them too early, it is extremely possible to enter the top ten.
If you successfully enter the top ten, the Master will personally recommend you to the Sima Sect Master to allow you to enter the Dark Night Hall. "
Hearing the master's words, Qin Fengming had a look of doubt on his face. He had no idea where the Dark Night Hall was, but from what the master said, it seemed to be a place that was better than the Elite Hall.
"Dark Night Hall is the secret entrance of our sect. Only the core disciples of our sect can enter. However, there are very few people who know the reality of this hall. Even the master does not know the specific location of Dark Night Hall.
But as long as you enter the Dark Night Hall, various martial arts training resources will be provided unlimitedly.
This is the place that any disciple of this sect longs for. "
Hearing the master's explanation, Qin Fengming was very excited.
It seems that Dark Night Hall should be the ultimate goal of Luoxia Valley disciples.
Although the master said that he could be recommended to join it, Qin Fengming knew that to get this opportunity, he had to pass several tests. In future competitions, there would be no room for negligence.
On the second day, the same valley was even more lively than yesterday.
However, the number of disciples participating in the competition today was only half of yesterday's.
At this time, Elder Wang came to the central high platform again:
“Today’s competition, there are only thirty-two people left, and we will take a knockout round, and the winner will directly enter the Elite Hall.
The losing party needs to take another test to determine the top four, and they can also enter the Elite Hall to continue their studies.
Okay, let's go get the number plate. "
Qin Fengming followed the other disciples and also received the number plate. This time the number plate was still randomly distributed, and each person's name was marked after the number plate.
"This competition will only be held on the high platform No. 5 in front. Disciples No. 1 and No. 32 will take the stage, No. 2 and No. 31 will prepare, and so on.
